fusions.name: Buckler Bash
fusions.desc: A bash that deals 14 damage, knocks the target back 3 tiles and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Skimming Throw
fusions.desc: Throws a woven disc that deals 4 damage. It then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Ward Stitch
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 28 damage and holds for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Guard Seam
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 50%, you gain a ward that soaks 30% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 60 seconds. Your armour is 8% higher.
